provenance.grid_resolution: NASA POWER point product; spatial support varies by parameter
provenance.precipitation_method: Monthly mean daily precipitation (mm/day) multiplied by the actual number of calendar days, then averaged across years

provenance.temperature_method: Daily tas in kelvin converted to degC; monthly daily means averaged across years, then equally averaged across models
provenance.precipitation_method: Daily pr in kg m-2 s-1 multiplied by 86,400 to obtain mm/day, summed within each month, averaged across years per model, then equally averaged across contributing models
provenance.climate_adjustment: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 is bias-corrected and downscaled; M1/M5 apply no additional delta adjustment
limitations: Model spread is a descriptive range, not a probability interval
Grid-cell projections are regional, not field-level forecasts

method.name: Calendar-month weighted standardized Euclidean distance
method.standardization: Per-month population standard deviation across valid candidate climates; 1 degC and 25 mm/month scale floors prevent zero variance
method.candidate_pool: Limited pool of 10 documented reference locations; not a global search
method.interpretation: Lower index means more similar within this candidate pool; not a probability

limitations: Climate matching does not establish soil, pest, water availability, management or crop suitability
All climate records are regional gridded evidence rather than a field sensor
Future target is a NASA bias-corrected/downscaled multi-model CMIP6 mean, not a deterministic weather forecast
Model spread is descriptive disagreement, not a probability interval
